geometry_C.description: two pass components, one stop, pi in I0 (the single-change counterpart to Sec 6.2, varying only m1)

enumeration_forced.L_must_be_even: kappa(pi)=0 for odd L, contradicting (C); pi in I0
enumeration_forced.sigma_forced: sigma=(-1)^(L/2) = (-1)^((n+d)/2), NOT a free parameter (single stop component)
enumeration_forced.excluded_a_priori: even d and the non-forced sign were NOT enumerated -- infeasible as theorems (spec Sec 3), not searched, not counted against budget

grids.E_grid: I1 grids with theta=0 dropped from the first component only (kappa(0)=1 identically) -- both for the optimisation constraint and for the reported active-E count (a) and (max_abs_kappa_I1_excluding_zero)

constraints.B: delta >= max_{G1}(Q-1) over both I1 components, epigraph
constraints.E: |kappa(theta)| <= 1 on the E grid (both I1 components, theta=0 dropped)

solver.name: scipy.optimize.minimize
solver.U_m_for_T_N: three-term Chebyshev recurrence (U_0=1, U_1=2x, U_m=2x U_{m-1}-U_{m-2}), NOT the sin/sinh division-based closed form, per this spec's explicit instruction

starts.random_distribution: alpha_j ~ N(0,0.35^2) i.i.d., matched via alpha_n
starts.antisym_distribution: free half ~ N(0,0.35^2), filled via alpha_j=-alpha_{n-j}
continuation: best alpha_first at (n,d-2), reused directly as a raw starting point
best alpha_first at (n-2,d), embedded via a zero-contrast layer at each end
starts.continuation_sigma_note: sigma here is a single value (not split free/forced) and is entirely re-derived at the target (n,d) as (-1)^((n+d)/2) -- it also flips between d and d-2, same mechanism as Geometry A's forced component -- so continuation carries only the numerical alpha, never a sigma

probe_seed.note: The brief cites a known feasible point (n=5,d=1,sigma=-1, delta~=3.29e-2) but supplies no explicit alpha vector to seed with, so no dedicated 'probe' start type was constructed -- this cell was solved with the standard random+antisym+continuation start set only, and its recovered value (0.032871412424680946) is checked post-hoc against the cited ~3.29e-2 as a validation, not injected as a seed.
probe_seed.check: PASS -- matches to the precision the brief quoted

starts.discard_rule: SLSQP res.success==False discarded; else fine-grid (16001-node) feasibility at tol 1e-9

rng.note: sweep_seed = 20260828+100, one stream consumed sequentially in n(3,5,7) x d(1,3,5,7,9) order
